rules.title: No bare rescue
rules.body: Never write a bare rescue or rescue => e that only logs and continues. Rescue the specific error classes you can handle and re-raise the rest.

rules.title: Strong parameters, never permit!
rules.body: Controllers list permitted attributes explicitly with params.require(...).permit(...); never use permit! or pass params straight to create or update.

rules.title: Eager load associations in lists
rules.body: Queries whose records are iterated with their associations use includes or preload so no query runs per record.

rules.title: Safe YAML and no eval on input
rules.body: Use YAML.safe_load for data from outside; never eval, instance_eval or send with values that came from users.

rules.title: Side effects after commit
rules.body: Emails, jobs and calls to other services triggered by a record change run in after_commit callbacks or after the transaction, never inside it.
